name: [UPD💣] Drift Tag
desc:
Welcome to Drift Tag 🚗💣 
Pass the bomb, dodge your rivals, and be the last driver standing!

❗ JOIN A LOW PING SERVER FOR BETTER HITBOXES

Grab a car and hit the streets in a high-speed game of hot-potato. 
🎮 Gamemodes only occur with 4 or more players in a server, [🔥] streaks are uneffected.
🏴‍☠️ Private server owners get permission to edit round/map, announce, and kick players. 
🚩 Report players via /report

💨 Features:

💣 Fast-paced bomb-tag rounds
🚗 Unlock 20+ cars as you progress
🎁 Open cases for rare vehicles & big rewards
🏆 Earn badges for clutch plays & win streaks
